source_review.notes: Checked the current RISC-V ISA, Ibex decode/execute and exception documentation, Linux x86 microcode-loader documentation, PicoRV32 RTL, Yosys FSM synthesis documentation, Sail RISC-V semantics and Nand to Tetris CPU/control material. All eight primary or official URLs returned HTTP 200. Educational control stores, open-core implementations and platform microcode-update mechanisms remain separately scoped.

evidence: Checked decoded input d, control state u, conditions f, control vector c, hardwired function H, control store M and sequencer Q notation.
Checked store depth/width, instruction fractions/cycles, clock period and noncommit/terminal-step definitions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The common transition contract does not assume either controller representation.

evidence: Recomputed 12,288-bit/1,536-byte horizontal and 8,704-bit/1,088-byte vertical stores with 29.17% raw reduction.
Recomputed hardwired 3.25 CPI at 1.25 ns as 4.06 ns and 246.15 MIPS; microcoded 3.70 CPI at 1.32 ns as 4.88 ns and 204.75 MIPS.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The deterministic Python snippet reproduced every expected value.

evidence: Re-derived H(d,u,f)=(c,u') and M[u]=(c,b), u'=Q(b,d,f) as alternative representations of sequencing.
Checked commit-aligned stuttering refinement, control-store capacity and weighted-CPI equations.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Representation equivalence is architectural-trace equivalence, not cycle equality.

evidence: Reviewed illegal states/words, stale conditions, wait loops, duplicate stores, late responses, microcall depth, reset, interrupts and control-store integrity errors.
Reviewed signed-but-incompatible patches, anti-rollback, interrupted/partial activation, mixed core versions, hotplug, combined control/datapath timing and debug exposure.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Functional, protocol, update-security, multicore and physical boundaries receive separate treatment.

evidence: Checked defined controls, legal dispatch, resource compatibility, intermediate validity, valid sequencing and request/response uniqueness.
Checked writes, commit, exceptions, interrupts, reset/integrity, progress, timing and image/evidence binding across fifteen obligations.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external computer-architecture academic, ISA/core maintainer, RTL/control-store designer, processor vendor, OS microcode-loader maintainer, synthesis/physical-timing engineer, formal verifier, security assessor, independent-verification or certification review is claimed.
